scenario: The ego vehicle travels straight through a busy urban intersection and is struck on its right side by a white passenger car that cuts across multiple lanes.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward through the intersection and is struck on its right side by another vehicle.

adversarials.behavior: The white passenger car cuts aggressively across two lanes of traffic from the right and collides with the ego vehicle's right side.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle is on a multi-lane urban road approaching and entering a busy intersection, with the adversarial white car initially positioned in lanes to the right of the ego before cutting across into the ego's path.
requirements_and_restrictions: The scenario involves heavy traffic conditions with multiple vehicles in adjacent lanes; the collision occurs as the ego enters the intersection area.

road_side_structures.position: Visible overhead on the right side of the road near the intersection.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The ego is identified from the first-person dashboard camera perspective; the white car is the sole adversarial. 2. Chronology: Initially, ego approaches intersection in straight lane with traffic ahead. At midpoint, white car appears from right lanes and cuts across. At ending, collision occurs on ego's right side. 3. Evidence: White car's lateral position shifts from right lanes into ego's lane; contact visible on ego's right side as white car enters intersection path.
